20798.d: Prifddinas (IPAc-en | p | r | ɪ | v | ˈ | θ | iː | n | ə | s Respell-en | priv | THEE | nuss ) is the greatest city of the elves and the capital city of Tirannwn.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
On foot
• Tirannwn lodestone teleport, then run north out of Isafdar forest, across the river, and into the southern entrance of the city
• From Arandar pass (accessible with the Sixth-Age circuit teleport to the World Gate, the Book of Char teleport, or the Eagles' Peak lodestone), run along the pass west to the eastern entrance of the city

Teleports to the Tower of Voices
• The Prifddinas lodestone is located in the Tower of Voices.
• Players in a clan may use the clan vexillum to teleport to the Clan citadel portal in the Tower of Voices.
• Any of the non-upgraded camouflage outfits can be used to teleport to the Tower of Voices.

Teleports to specific areas
• The crystal teleport seed (and its attuned version) provides teleports to all eight districts.
• The full master camouflage outfit can be used to teleport to all eight districts.
• The House Teleport spell brings players to the Ithell district if players have moved their house accordingly.
• The max cape and completionist cape have unlimited teleports to the Max Guild in the Cadarn district.
• The Tirannwn quiver 4 offers teleports to the harmony pillars in the Meilyr district and Eluned/Islwyn in the Ithell district.
• The Dungeoneering cape can be used to teleport to the resource dungeons located in the Meilyr district.

Transportation networks
• Fairy ring DJS is located in the Amlodd district
• A gnome glider is located at the northernmost point of the city
• A spirit tree is located in the Crwys district (must have 89 Farming and speak to Glouron before this tree will accept incoming teleports)

gt.heading: Transportation networks
gt.text:
• Fairy ring DJS is located in the Amlodd district
• A gnome glider is located at the northernmost point of the city
• A spirit tree is located in the Crwys district (must have 89 Farming and speak to Glouron before this tree will accept incoming teleports)

20808.d: Prifddinas Waterfall Fishing is a Fishing activity that is located at the Prifddinas Waterfall between the Meilyr and Crwys districts in Prifddinas.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Players must climb the handholds set into the rock face to reach the top of the waterfall. A grapple shortcut, requiring level 90 Agility, Strength, and Ranged, must be traversed in order to reach the fishing spots. Temporary boosts are applicable to fulfil the requirement. The grapple shortcut requires an enhanced grappling hook, mithril grapple and crossbow equipped, or having built the hidey-hole.
• Players who meet the requirements of levels 90 Agility, Strength, and Ranged can teleport here by attuning a skilling portal in the Max Guild Garden to this location, which will teleport them to the tier 2 platform next to the bank chest. This requires at least one skill with level 99 or the Quest Cape to access the Garden, or an unattuned grace of the elves to use the teleport. Boosts cannot be used to tune the portal, even if players would otherwise be able to boost the levels to access the waterfall normally.
• Players can purchase Waterfall fishing teleports from the reward shop (for 300 urchin points) which can be used to teleport to the top of the waterfall near the bank chest. Using these teleports does not require levels 90 Agility, Strength or Ranged.
